rules_applied: Automatic generation once per session, 3-4 h after its end (was 1-2 h).
Automatic runs only Friday 00:00 - Monday 23:59 KST; Tuesday-Thursday excluded; explicit manual runs are not limited by weekday.
An explicit actual end (actual_date_end, or a later end found in metadata fetched at generation time) beats the scheduled date_end.
Schedule check reads only reports/catalog/sessions.json, reports/weekend-*/sessions.json and the attempt record; zero external calls.
Collector fetches session metadata plus data for the gate-selected sessions only; other sessions keep cached snapshots. Manual runs keep full collection.

First automatic attempt per session recorded in reports/catalog/report-attempts.json before any request; started, auth_restricted, missing, failed and not_published are not completed and are not retried automatically; retries are manual.
If the fetched metadata shows a later end, no data is collected; deferred_end_later with the later end is recorded and the gate waits for end + 3 h.

State-only commit of the attempt record when no report is committed (unchanged, 401, missing, failure, deferred); no report regeneration, Claude review or delivery. Collected data that was not committed is recorded as not_published.
